# llms.txt — Homestay Kenangan
# Spec: https://llmstxt.org/

> Homestay Kenangan runs two family homestays in Terengganu, Malaysia: one in
> Kemaman (3 bedrooms) and one in Kuala Terengganu (4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms).
> Both are self check-in, air conditioned, with full kitchen, free parking and
> WiFi. Bookings are confirmed on WhatsApp at +60 19-914 4505.

## Locations

- [Kemaman homestay](https://homestay-kenangan.vercel.app/#about): 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, 1 toilet. Suited to families of up to 8. Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/KyBmg1iwgqLiSsha9
- [Kuala Terengganu homestay](https://homestay-kenangan.vercel.app/#about): 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms. Suited to large families and groups. Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/SCBDByiRjyYQefny6

## Pages

- [Home](https://homestay-kenangan.vercel.app/): Overview, booking call to action, gallery highlights.
- [About Us](https://homestay-kenangan.vercel.app/about): Story, both locations, why guests choose us.
- [Gallery](https://homestay-kenangan.vercel.app/gallery): Room and facility photos for both locations.
- [Facilities](https://homestay-kenangan.vercel.app/facilities): Amenities list — kitchen, WiFi, TV, parking, air conditioning.
- [FAQ](https://homestay-kenangan.vercel.app/faq): Check-in times, house rules, amenities, booking questions.
- [Contact](https://homestay-kenangan.vercel.app/contact): WhatsApp, phone, email and price range.

## Facts

- Booking channel: WhatsApp +60 19-914 4505 (no online payment on this site).
- Email: kenangan.homestay@gmail.com
- Region: Terengganu, Malaysia. Nearest attractions include Batu Buruk Beach, Crystal Mosque, Pasar Payang (Kuala Terengganu) and Kemaman beaches.
- Currency: MYR. Prices are quoted per night on the contact page.
- Languages: English (site), Malay and English (guest communication).
